home.kicker: Software engineer, PhD in computer graphics
home.lead: Seventeen projects, about fifteen languages, one common thread: 3D meshes and their topology. Each project is generated with AI, then reviewed, tested and documented by me.
home.thread.title: The common thread
home.thread.text: One mesh runs through the whole portfolio: read in C, analysed in C++, served by Python, Java and C# APIs, classified by an ML model, stored in SQL and displayed in React, Angular and Qt.
home.genai.title: Generated by AI, reviewed by a human
home.genai.text: The code is written with Claude Code. My added value: the specification, a review of every diff, the tests and a blocking CI. Each project has a REVIEW.md file listing the AI mistakes I fixed.
